summary: SUNation Energy filed an 8-K on June 5, 2026, announcing a merger agreement to acquire Suniva via a forward triangular merger with its wholly owned Merger Sub. Under the agreement, outstanding Suniva shares, warrants, and RSUs will convert into SUNation common stock at an exchange ratio, with pre-merger Suniva stockholders expected to own ~98.2% of the combined company and SUNation stockholders ~1.8%, subject to net cash adjustments. The transaction is structured as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). SUNation did not disclose a board recommendation, advisors, or breakup fee. Risk-arb: watch Nasdaq listing compliance and shareholder approvals.
